summary: EDAP TMS SA filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for an underwritten public offering of 8,425,000 ADSs at $4.75 per ADS, with a 30-day option for 1,263,750 additional ADSs. Expected to close August 14, 2026, net proceeds about $37.1 million for operating costs and general corporate purposes. Standard underwriting terms, lock-ups for officers and directors for 90 days. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
